# halos_experiments (Data Source)

Experiments defined in policy with their status (GET /api/v1/experiments). Read only: experiments are started, paused and concluded by a human, not by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "halos_experiments" "this" {}

output "running_experiments" {
  value = [for e in data.halos_experiments.this.experiments : e.name if e.status == "running"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `experiments` (Attributes List) Experiments in policy order. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--experiments))
- `id` (String) Always `experiments`.

<a id="nestedatt--experiments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `experiments`

Read-Only:

- `axis` (String) `client` or `gateway`.
- `name` (String) Experiment name.
- `rings` (List of String) Rings the experiment runs in.
- `status` (String) `draft`, `running`, `paused` or `concluded`.
- `type` (String) Experiment type, for example `ab` or `shadow`.
